title: KAITO — Happy Anniversary! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, everyone!
Welcome to KAITO's anniversary show!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is everybody ready to get hyped?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe, those are some impressive cheers.
It felt like you shook the whole venue.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Seems like everyone's all ready to go!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay then, how about we use that volume to call today's star out here?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Here we go... One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: KAITOOO!
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thanks for coming today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Everyone watching the stream, can you all hear me too?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Whoa! The comments are coming in so fast.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, look!
Someone said, “Thanks for giving us the chance to celebrate, KAITO”!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
They're thanking me...?
I'm the one who should be thanking them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm able to keep singing because of all the people who cheer me on by sending me comments or coming to my shows.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, today I'd like to express my gratitude to everyone who supports me... And I want this show to be one we can all enjoy together!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's a lovely thought.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. We want those feelings to reach everyone... So we'll do our best to help in any way we can!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, should we jump right into the first song?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Here's the first song of KAITO's special anniversary show!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I hear you all loud and clear!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This thought struck me again as I was up here singing... All of your voices really do give me strength.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thanks for giving me so much!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Next, it won't just be me... I'll have Miku and the others singing by my side.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'll sing my very best to convey my gratitude to all of you...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So I hope you'll enjoy yourselves to the end!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You've all still got energy to spare, don't you?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha! You really do have a way of getting the crowd excited, MEIKO. Alright, I'll give it a shot too...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Come on, everybody! You can get louder than that, right?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright guys! We're all gonna go out a bit closer to where you're at!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You too, KAITO, c'mon!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Whoa, whoa, calm down! I'm going, so there's no need to push!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wooow, so much cheering...! Len, we've gotta join in!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: For sure!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Everyone watching the stream, are you enjoying yourselves as well?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, look here!
One of the comments says, “I was looking forward to this show a whole lot!”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Getting comments like this makes me really happy too.
I can feel a connection, even with someone who's far away...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'll put all the feeling I can into this song, in hopes that it reaches you all! Here I go!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: How was it seeing us sing together in that segment?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. It sounds like they enjoyed it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! How was it for you, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I enjoyed it too. It was really nice getting to sing with you all, and also...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As we were singing together, I realized once again just how much support you all give me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I heard your passionate singing right beside me, and it made my chest tighten... It really drove home that I'm able to keep singing because of all of you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I tried to convey that gratitude to each of you with my singing, but... Did it work?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Of course it did!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. I felt like I really got in touch with your feelings by singing with you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see... I'm glad.
How about everyone in the audience?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: All of you here at the venue and everyone watching the stream are supporting me as well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So I hope my thanks came through to you in my singing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow! That's the loudest cheering we've heard all day!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
There's lots of comments too!
I can't even keep up with them anymore!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Everyone... Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Alrighty then, now that KAITO's shared his lovely thoughts...
It's time for our messages♪
song00010_off_s

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, KAITO!
It made me happy to sing with you today too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I could feel so much emotion in the way you sang!
I hope next time you'll let me share my feelings with you through song.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, KAITO!
That was a really great show, packed with all your feelings!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
How did Len and I do as MCs? We practiced a whole lot together!
I hope we were able to help get everyone excited, at least a little bit!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I was a little nervous at the start of the show... But I think we did even better than when we practiced, so I wanna hear what you thought later!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Still... From the way those cheers sounded just now, I'd say this show was a huge success!
I'll say it one more time, happy anniversary KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, KAITO.
It's always quite soothing to sing by your side.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You said that we all support you, KAITO... But in the same way, you support all of us. Thank you for everything, including the days to come.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We really can always rely on you. That's why it was so nice to hear how you feel today... And why I'm so glad that we got to sing our hearts out together.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. It definitely is fun to sing with you!
Let's do it again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay, let's all wish KAITO a happy anniversary!
One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you all so much...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In the same way you felt the emotions in my singing, I can also feel a lot from all of you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's because of those supportive feelings that I can keep singing today...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And I'd like to continue singing lots of songs together in the future...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So I hope you'll keep cheering me on!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Leave it to us! We'll be cheering you on forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thanks, Rin.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And all of you... Thank you for helping me make this such an exciting show!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd like to thank everyone who watched as well... Thank you so much! This was a wonderful anniversary that I'll never forget.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Come hear me sing again anytime you like.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright then... Until we meet again!
